title: Volodymyr Zelenskyy awards Elon Musk with Ukraine's Order of Freedom; sources say Zelenskyy asked Musk to authorize Starlink use up to 200km inside Russia (Fabrice Deprez/Financial Times)
summary: Fabrice Deprez / Financial Times: Volodymyr Zelenskyy awards Elon Musk with Ukraine's Order of Freedom; sources say Zelenskyy asked Musk to authorize Starlink use up to 200km inside Russia — Tech billionaire reluctant to allow satellite system to be used for drone strikes deep inside Russia
